document.about: BMC Genomics 2007, 8:307, 'Living with an imperfect cell wall: compensation of femAB inactivation in Staphylococcus aureus', PMC2045680. Its Table 3 (p8) lists metabolites in the page's right column, ruled only at the top, under the header and at the foot. Several names carry a qualifier wrapped onto the next line (`Uracil` over `(extracellular)`), set as far below as the next row. The PDF is linked from the PMC article page; PMC refuses scripted downloads.

notes: 2026-11-25 (#371): each `(extracellular)` line ended the table. The rows after the first became pieces headed `(extracellular)` or paragraphs. A bracket opening on a lowercase word runs on from the line above, as a lowercase start does; a list's enumerator in brackets does not.

checks.issue: #371: `(extracellular)` was the header of a new piece of the table.
#371: the table's last rows were a piece of their own, with no column names.
